messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Missing butterworth filter?
parts:
Hi Sean,

When I do a quick search for these filters in R:

help.search("butter")
I get hits suggesting that the butter and buttord functions can be found in the signal package and that the bwfilter is in the seewave package.

Have you made sure to load the relevant libraries before starting?
library(seewave)
library(signal)
Whenever I see the "'x' function not found" error message 99% of the time it's because I hadn't loaded the library when I thought I did.

Steffi
Dr. Stefanie LaZerte
Natural Resources and Environmental Studies
University of Northern BC
stefanie...@unbc.ca
http://steffi.ca/
On 2017-02-13 07:13 PM, Sean Hardison wrote:
Hi everybody,

I posted earlier about the absence of the 'butter' and 'butterord' functions, but then I found the bwfilter function, which was working well for me earlier today. The problem now is that when I try to use bwfilter I get an error message saying " 'bwfilter' not found". The function is also absent from the vignette that's accessible from the help window. Anyone have similar problems? I've tried reinstalling seewave, tuneR and signal with no success.

Thanks,

Sean

Stefanie,

Thanks for your response. The error was (not surprisingly) totally on me. I had been working on two different computers, and the second computer had not yet updated its version of R, which made bwfilter() unavailable in seewave.

Sean
